NEWS 


FROM THE MONTREAL YMCA 


1441 DRUMMOND ST., MONTREAL 
TELEPHONE 849-5331, EXT. 57 


February 4th, 1965 


Lachine-Dorval Y.M.C.A« to conduct community leadership project 


Some 30 representatives of many community organizations in Lachine area 
will take part in a leadership development project at the Lachine~Dorval 


y.M.C.A- beginning Monday February 8th, at 8.00 p.m. 


The program will run on five successive Monday evenings with leadership 
provided by three members of the Y.M.C.A. staff assisted by the Rev.David 


Estey and Rix Rogers of the Metropolitan Y.M.C.A. staff. 


In announcing this new program, Victor Hryhorchuk, Executive Secretary of 
the Lachine-Dorval Y.M.C.A. pointed out that this is a community service 
project of the Y.M.C.A. designed to bring together representatives of many 
different segments of the organizational life of the community. The 
project has been made possible with the assistance of the Lakeshore 


Kiwanis Club with staff and facilities provided by the Y.M.C.A. 


The main focus of the program will be human relations and leadership 


training in small groups. 


In addition to introducing many of the leaders to the most up-to-date 
techniques of leadership training, the program will provide many 


opportunities for leaders of the various organizations to share their 


newest asweedt 


common concerns and become familiar with the work of the other organizations 


serving the community. 


For further detail contact: 
Vietor Hryhorchuk, Executive Secretary, Lachine-Dorval Y.M.C.A. 637-2511/2 


or Ted Lowe, Secretary for Public Relations, Montreal Y.M.C.A., 849-5331, 
loc .57
